title: Trump Responds To Concerns About Market Reaction To Tariffs: ‘Tariffs Don’t Cause Inflation’
summary: Pre-inauguration Trump presser: tariffs don't cause inflation, the first term took in hundreds of billions from other countries with almost no inflation, other countries tariff the US while it charges none, and the EU VAT is a tariff.

assertions.quote: tariffs don't cause inflation they cause success cause big success
I had almost no inflation and took in uh $600 billion dollar of money from other countries

verdicts.note: Inflation stayed near 2% in 2018-19, but tariffed goods such as washing machines rose in price and total first-term tariff revenue was roughly $230 billion, paid by US importers.

The 2018-2019 tariffs passed through 100 percent into U.S. import prices with no exporter absorption, so U.S. buyers paid them in full; the post does not measure the aggregate inflation effect or the revenue raised.

assertions.quote: took in uh $600 billion dollar of money from other countries and uh tariffs don't cause inflation
the tariffs are going to make us very rich and very strong
there could be some temporary short-term disruption and people will understand that

verdicts.note: The price-level effect of a tariff is one-time, but the 2025 tariffs' drag on growth and goods prices lasted beyond a few months and the deficit did not shrink.

The tariff contribution to twelve-month goods inflation is temporary, fading to zero within about eighteen months, but tariffs leave the consumer goods price level permanently higher and the full effect takes a year to appear; the post covers prices only, not wider economic effects.

assertions.quote: other countries charge us tariffs we don't charge them tariffs

verdicts.note: The US applied tariffs averaging about 3% before 2025 with high peaks on trucks, footwear and sugar; most partners' averages were similar.
The U.S. average tariff rate on imports was 2.6 percent at the start of 2025, before the new tariffs, so the U.S. was not charging zero; the post does not compare this to other countries' rates.

assertions.quote: the European Union charges us 20% plus plus plus a vat tax called a vat tax very similar

verdicts.note: VAT applies equally to domestic and imported goods and is rebated on exports, so it does not discriminate against US products.
